programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Young professionals Jack and Laura have sold their home in the city and are searching for a lakeside escape; the first home on their search is a beautiful rustic home; the second home has an open-concept kitchen; the third home have a secret door.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Retired couple Janet and Tom search for a lakefront property to enjoy fishing, one of their favorite pastimes. Their hunt leads them to three homes, all with unique amenities.

programs.title: Lakefront Luxury
programs.desc: Empty nesters Carlo and Cat are looking for a home with amazing lake views, a large kitchen, and space for their dogs; on the hunt for their dream lakefront property, they first view a modern farmhouse with a large kitchen, a games room, a wine cellar and a boathouse; the second house they view is a contemporary home with a chef's kitchen, sauna and a descending trail to the lake; the last home on their tour is a 5-bedroom ranch-style home with lake views, a wine cellar and a movie theater.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: First-time builders Shay and Shae set out to build a home using five shipping containers on a wooded lot in Oklahoma.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: In Washington State's Cascade Mountains, a couple builds their 2,400-square-foot dream cabin; the location gives them amazing views, but hauling heavy beams up dusty switchbacks on a six-month deadline pushes them to their limits.

programs.title: Building Off the Grid
programs.desc: Builder Phil Parr heads to the wilderness of northern Colorado to build the ultimate off-grid tent; far beyond simple nylon and poles, this lavish tent has a custom fabricated wooden frame, canvas shell and 650-square-feet of livable elegance.
